description: Work out a business tax filing deadline and estimate the late penalty: Pakistan income tax return (Income Tax Ordinance s.118 with official FBR extensions; s.182 penalty) and quarterly withholding statements (s.165), UAE Corporate Tax return and payment (9 months after the tax period; registration deadline under FTA Decision 3/2024; Cabinet Decision 75/2023 penalties), UAE VAT return and payment (28th day after the tax period; Cabinet Decision 40/2017 as amended by Cabinet Decision 129/2025), Saudi VAT tax period and due date (Implementing Regulations Arts. 58, 59, 62, 74; VAT Law penalties). Every line cites its legal reference and official source; unconfirmed facts are marked "Being verified" and not used. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested filing module.

filed.description: Optional: date the return or statement was or will be filed (estimates the late-filing penalty). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

filing.description: Which deadline: pk_income_tax_return = Pakistan income tax return (Income Tax Ordinance s.118, penalty s.182); pk_withholding_statement = Pakistan quarterly withholding statement (s.165); uae_corporate_tax = UAE Corporate Tax return and payment (Federal Decree-Law 47/2022) with optional registration deadline; uae_vat = UAE VAT return and payment (VAT Executive Regulation Art. 64); saudi_vat = Saudi VAT tax period, return and payment (VAT Implementing Regulations Arts. 58, 59, 62).

incorporated.description: uae_corporate_tax, optional: date the business was set up (checks the FTA Decision 7/2024 postponement for first tax periods ending on or before 29 February 2024). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

monthly_approved.description: saudi_vat: true if ZATCA approved or directed a monthly tax period although supplies are not over SAR 40,000,000.

paid.description: Optional: date the tax was or will be paid (uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat with unpaid_tax; saudi_vat with vat_due). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end.description: uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat, saudi_vat: last day of the tax period (Saudi: a month end). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

quarter_end_month.description: pk_withholding_statement: month the quarter ends (3 = March, 6 = June, 9 = September, 12 = December).

registration_start.description: uae_corporate_tax, with registration_type: the date that starts the registration period (see registration_type). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

registration_type.description: uae_corporate_tax, optional (gives the registration deadline, FTA Decision 3/2024): res_new = resident company set up on or after 1 March 2024; res_old = resident company set up before 1 March 2024 (registration_start = issue date of its earliest licence); res_foreign = foreign company managed and controlled in the UAE (registration_start = end of its financial year); nr_pe = non-resident with a permanent establishment (registration_start = date the PE came into existence); nr_nexus = non-resident with a nexus (date the nexus was established); np_res = resident individual doing business with turnover over AED 1 million (a date in the calendar year the threshold was passed); np_nr = non-resident individual (date the conditions were met).

repeat_within_24_months.description: uae_vat, with filed: true if a late return was already penalised in the previous 24 months.

tax_payable.description: pk_income_tax_return: tax payable for the year in PKR (the higher of assessed tax and the last duly filed year's tax). Needed with filed to estimate the late-filing penalty.

tax_year_end.description: pk_income_tax_return: last day of the tax year (normal tax year ends 30 June, e.g. 2026-06-30 = tax year 2026; special tax years end on another month end). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

taxable_supplies_12m.description: saudi_vat: value of taxable supplies in the last 12 months in SAR (over SAR 40,000,000 = monthly tax period).

taxpayer_type.description: pk_income_tax_return: company; salaried = individual with 75% or more of income from salary; other = other individual or association of persons (AOP).

unpaid_tax.description: uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat, with paid: tax paid late, in AED.

vat_due.description: saudi_vat, with filed or paid: VAT due for the period in SAR (to estimate the fines).

withheld_tax_paid_on_time.description: pk_withholding_statement, with filed: yes = the tax withheld or collected was paid by its due date; no = it was not; nil = no tax was required to be withheld or collected.

year.description: pk_withholding_statement: calendar year the quarter ends in, e.g. 2026.

name: business_filing_deadline
title: Business filing deadlines (Pakistan, UAE, Saudi Arabia)
